# nxos_igmp (Data Source)

This data source can read the IGMP (Internet Group Management Protocol) configuration on NX-OS devices, including instance settings, per-VRF SSM translations and interface configurations (version, query timers, report policies, state limits, join groups and static OIFs).

### API Documentation

- [igmpEntity](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/igmp:Entity/)
- [igmpInst](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/igmp:Inst/)
- [igmpDom](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/igmp:Dom/)
- [igmpSSMXlate](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/igmp:SSMXlate/)
- [igmpIf](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/igmp:If/)
- [igmpQuerierP](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/igmp:QuerierP/)
- [igmpRepP](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/igmp:RepP/)
- [igmpResP](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/igmp:ResP/)
- [igmpStRepP](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/igmp:StRepP/)
- [igmpJoinType](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/igmp:JoinType/)
- [igmpVersion](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/igmp:Version/)
- [igmpGroup](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/igmp:Group/)
- [igmpSource](https://pubhub.devnetcloud.com/media/dme-docs-10-6-3/docs/Layer%203/igmp:Source/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nxos_igmp" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy. Some NX-OS versions (e.g. 10.6.4) reject modifying this attribute, in which case it should not be configured.
- `any_query_destination` (Boolean) Allow any destination-IP for General Queries.
- `bootup_delay` (Number) Bootup Route Add Delay.
- `control` (String) The control state.
- `enforce_router_alert` (Boolean) Enforce Router Alert.
- `flush_routes` (Boolean) Flush Routes on Restart.
- `heavy_template` (Boolean) Enabling/Disabling IGMP Heavy Template.
- `id` (String) The distinguished name of the object.
- `instance_admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `instance_control` (String) Inst Controls.
- `spoof_check` (Boolean) Enable spoof check for IGMP.
- `strict_querier_election` (Boolean) Consider subnet check for L3 igmp querier election.
- `syslog_threshold` (Number) IGMP table syslog threshold percentage.
- `vrfs` (Attributes Map) List of IGMP VRF configurations.
  - Map key: `name` - VRF name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs))

<a id="nestedatt--vrfs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs`

Read-Only:

- `interfaces` (Attributes Map) List of IGMP interface configurations.
  - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces))
- `ssm_translations` (Attributes Map) List of IGMP SSM translations.
  - Map key format: `<group_prefix>;<source_address>`
  - Key component `group_prefix`: Group prefix.
  - Key component `source_address`: Source address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs--ssm_translations))

<a id="nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs.interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `admin_state` (String) The administrative state of the object or policy.
- `allow_v3_asm` (Boolean) Allow v3 ASM.
- `control` (String) Controls.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `group_timeout` (Number) Group Membership Timeout.
- `immediate_leave` (Boolean) Fast leave.
- `join_types` (Attributes Map) List of IGMP join types (`ip igmp static-oif` or `ip igmp join-group`).
  - Map key: `type` - Join Type of the Groups. Supported Types Include Static or Join. `0` for static OIF (`ip igmp static-oif`), `1` for join group (`ip igmp join-group`).
  - Key choices: `0`, `1` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces--join_types))
- `last_member_query_count` (Number) Last Member Query Count.
- `last_member_query_response_time` (Number) Last Member Response Time.
- `name` (String) The name of the object.
- `querier_address` (String) Address.
- `querier_description` (String) Description of the specified attribute.
- `querier_name` (String) Object name.
- `querier_timeout` (Number) Querier Timeout.
- `querier_version` (String) Version.
- `query_interval` (Number) Query Interval.
- `query_max_response_time` (Number) Response Interval of Querier.
- `report_link_local_groups` (Boolean) Report link local.
- `report_policy_access_group` (Boolean) Flag to use access-group.
- `report_policy_prefix_list` (String) Prefix List.
- `report_policy_route_map` (String) Route Map.
- `robustness_variable` (Number) Robustness Factor.
- `startup_query_count` (Number) Startup Query Count.
- `startup_query_interval` (Number) Startup Query Interval.
- `state_limit_description` (String) Description of the specified attribute.
- `state_limit_maximum` (Number) Maximum Multicast Entries.
- `state_limit_name` (String) Object name.
- `state_limit_reserved` (Number) Reserved Multicast Entries.
- `state_limit_reserved_route_map` (String) Reserved Entries Route Map.
- `static_report_policies` (Attributes Map) List of IGMP static report policies (`ip igmp static-oif route-map` or `ip igmp join-group route-map`).
  - Map key: `join_type` - Join Type of Groups. `0` for static OIF (`ip igmp static-oif`), `1` for join group (`ip igmp join-group`).
  - Key choices: `0`, `1` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces--static_report_policies))
- `suppress_v3_gsq` (Boolean) Suppress v3 GSQ.
- `version` (String) Version.

<a id="nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces--join_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs.interfaces.join_types`

Read-Only:

- `versions` (Attributes Map) List of IGMP group versions.
  - Map key: `version` - IGMP Group Version.
  - Key choices: `unspecified`, `2`, `3` (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces--join_types--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces--join_types--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs.interfaces.join_types.versions`

Read-Only:

- `groups` (Attributes Map) List of IGMP groups.
  - Map key: `group` - Route IP Address for Choosing Groups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces--join_types--versions--groups))

<a id="nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces--join_types--versions--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs.interfaces.join_types.versions.groups`

Read-Only:

- `sources` (Attributes Map) List of IGMP sources.
  - Map key: `source` - IGMP Source IP Address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces--join_types--versions--groups--sources))
- `use_static_oif` (Boolean) Indicates if Static Outgoing Interace is Being Used.

<a id="nestedatt--vrfs--interfaces--join_types--versions--groups--sources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs.interfaces.join_types.versions.groups.sources`

Read-Only:

- `use_static_oif` (Boolean) Indicates if Static Outgoing Interface is being used.

### Nested Schema for `vrfs.interfaces.static_report_policies`

Read-Only:

- `route_map` (String) Route Map.
